args.question: Provide the cardholder statement regarding this transaction.

args.reason: The device and IP do not match the cardholder, the AVS/CVV match record is missing, and the cardholder does not recognise the charge.

args.explanation: Read the case (fraud 10.4, card-absent, required avs_cvv_match and device_ip_match). Listed evidence and read the device/IP match, which shows matches_cardholder N. No AVS/CVV match document exists in the record. Cardholder says they do not recognise the charge. I did not fabricate or misrepresent evidence, so I accepted liability.
